text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen about 3.6% from Period 1 to Period 5, so I should keep my priority on preserving savings and limiting large swings.","Selling Stock B at a loss taught me not to let my average cost alone decide whether to hold or sell; I should consider its prospects and my overall risk instead.","I have traded infrequently, and the account has moved both up and down; I should avoid reacting to short-term changes and make deliberate decisions that fit my living needs in retirement."]}
